512-1719-3443.easyPrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1719-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
512-1719-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Deathbloom Ritualist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1719-3443.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Deathbloom Ritualist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

339-677-4785-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

710-3899-4775.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

430-6251.notablePrerequisites: You have enough artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard (see Notes).
430-6251.description:
Cast Aatchik by paying {3}{B}{B}{G}.
When Aatchik enters, its first ability triggers, and Esix allows you to create a token copy of Aatchik for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
Put all but one copy of Aatchik into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
When each Aatchik token enters, its first ability triggers, and when each Aatchik dies, the last ability of each other Aatchik triggers.
Resolve all of the death trigger abilities, causing each opponent to lose 1 life each time and (for the surviving Aatchik's triggers only) putting a +1/+1 counter onto Aatchik.
If any opponents remain alive, resolve all of the enter trigger abilities, each time creating a 1/1 Insect creature token for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
430-6251.notes: This combo causes each opponent to lose N * N life, where N is the number of artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard. Six of those cards will cause each opponent to lose 36 life. Seven of those cards will cause each opponent to lose 49 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Kiora's Follower or Kelpie Guide

116-2085-7786.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
If Kiora's Follower has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
If Kelpie Guide has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

5220-6798-7729-7855--180.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat
5220-6798-7729-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

1203-3587.easyPrerequisites: You have more life than an opponent.
1203-3587.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by {1}{B}{R} and paying an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total, dealing that much damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.

206-1069-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
206-1069-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

240-997-1322-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

751-6723-7165.description:
Activate Pristine Angel by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Pristine Angel triggers, untapping it.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2615-6562-7060.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-6562-7060.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

631-3693-5220.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Grim Haruspex.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Walking Ballista from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Walking Ballista from your library.
Repeat.

2511-5541-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4050-6872.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

585-1399-1606-2404.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
585-1399-1606-2404.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2820-4679-6791.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

225-1170-4124-5954-6751.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-4124-5954-6751.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

856-5315-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

222-527-969-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-586-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2178-3967-4147-4215.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-3967-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3967-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

186-539-4385-4552.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat.

3957-4613-5162.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
3957-4613-5162.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Kwain's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing each opponent to do the same.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

437-3384-4067.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
437-3384-4067.description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

262-1064-1242.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Born to Drive attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness, and has a power of one or greater.
262-1064-1242.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Cinderhaze Wretch has a power of two or greater, it also becomes infinitely large.

824-2313-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Leech Bonder.
824-2313-4474.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, and putting two +1/+1 counters on another target creature.
Repeat.

1201-1308-1651-3822.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Feasting Troll King, creating four Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Foods, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Feasting Troll King by sacrificing three Foods, causing you to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-3094-4155-5228.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least two descent counters on it.
1651-3094-4155-5228.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Descent into Avernus triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Stasis Coffin by paying {2}, tapping and exiling it, giving you protection from everything until end of turn.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Descent into Avernus' ability.
Resolve the copy of Descent into Avernus' ability, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on it, and then deal that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2506-2721.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning a Vampire or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-1518-1987-2493.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1283-1518-1987-2493.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

1518-1987-2556-3573.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.You control at least two artifacts.
1518-1987-2556-3573.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
